name: Hawknet
summary: Small regional ISP in North Richmond (Hawkesbury), NSW. Held a full /21 in the 1997 IP Network Index (HAWKNET-AU 203.33.112.0-203.33.119.255); 1999 site had customer account/usage pages (ColdFusion) and hosted personal user sites; ISP-era hosting continued into early 2006. The domain's farewell page announced that 'Hypermax Internet' would cease internet/email services from 16 Jun 2006, diverting customers to Telstra BigPond. The corporate shell continued as Hawknet Australia Licensing Pty Ltd (ACN 093 338 884; GST cancelled 1 Jan 2020); the domain later hosted a personal blog behind a Cloudflare check.

events.details: ISP-era operation evidenced by Wayback captures of customer account/usage pages (a-accounts.cfm, a-getusage.cfm, May 1999) and hosted personal user sites (e.g. hawknet.com.au/-jkerr, -ozrepublic) — classic small-ISP hosting pattern. Not to be confused with HawkNet Labs (hawknet-labs, Leichhardt NSW, founded 2024), an unrelated later entity.

events.details: hawknet.com.au carried an ISP farewell page announcing 'From Friday 16th June 2006 Hypermax will no longer provide your internet access and email services' and diverting customers to Telstra BigPond — the end of ISP service delivery on the domain. ISP-era hosting is evidenced up to early 2006 (customer user pages captured Jan-May 2006: ~afx, ~altitude, ~dsimon, ~gin, ~henriw, ~hrmoller). The corporate shell continued as Hawknet Australia Licensing Pty Ltd (ACN 093 338 884, Hawkesbury NSW; ABN active from 16 Jun 2000; GST cancelled 1 Jan 2020) — a licensing entity, not the ISP operator. NOTE: the exact Hawknet-to-Hypermax brand relationship is not fully documented; the farewell page is the operative closure evidence.
